candidateDecisions.label: Digital innovation and management
candidateDecisions.reason: Strategy & Digital Transformation and Business & Economy in the Age of AI already contribute to the broad option. A separate digital option could add technical analytics, but would overlap the finance and analytics option’s methods while losing financial depth. The three retained options cover more distinct business questions.

stoppingDecision.assessment: The broad option covers business functions and venture development. The two related options add sustained study of sustainable operations and of finance and quantitative decision-making. The digital direction contributes to the broad and analytical options.

analysis: The closest option progresses through business foundations, economics and research methods to strategic choices, marketing, product development and market research. The workbook provides actual venture models, financial statements, global market-entry analysis, organisational psychology and AI cases. The sustainability option uses the same business foundations, then life-cycle assessment, circular processes, sustainable farming, governance, energy and company-facing renewable design. Product Design supplies customer research, costing, resource use and repairability, so contributes to sustainable operations as well as ventures. Sustainability Essentials II is primarily physical science and measurement for environmental technologies. The finance option anchors accounting in costing, budgeting and investment appraisal, and develops financial markets, bank capital, liquidity and risk. Quantitative methods include regression, predictive validation, probability, optimisation and numerical methods. The description-only Econometrics, Behavioral Economics, Market Research, Strategy & Digital Transformation, Database Management Systems and Renewable System Design have substantive roles within the limits of their stated material. General analytics are not specialised corporate valuation or portfolio training. The digital candidate would duplicate strategy and AI study or overlap the third option’s analytics. The broad option owns venture and creative innovation through actual business models and prototyping. The corrected alignment pairs cross-border management to International Business rather than law, pairs legal subject matter separately, and leaves dedicated operations and the thesis unmatched. Dedicated management accounting overlaps with costing and budgets in UCR’s combined accounting course, counted only once. The 6 EC required thesis is distinct from optional UCR research.
